description: A company's registered charges in plain English. From the Companies House register of charges - total and outstanding, the lenders (individuals never named), what each secures and over what, fixed or floating, a floating charge over everything, and the latest creation date. 1 credit. Use this for who has lent against the company and over what; for the company's health use distress_signals, for a first look across the record public_record.

company.description: A UK company number (8 characters, such as 00502851 or SC123456) is surest; a name also works and goes to the closest registered company, which the reply names. Use company_search first when a name could mean several companies.
